Q5910.reason: A recorded general-plan restriction barring structures on the strip is most likely an equitable servitude, though negative easement is a close alternative.

Q5623.reason: The commentary was opinion aimed at a class of professors, not a false statement of fact about the professor, so he likely loses.

Q5004.reason: The executory interest in the sister's children who reach 25 can vest too remotely, because the class stays open, so it violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and the friend holds the lot alone.
